headline: Lease for APC Tides Program, math curriculum review, school policy readings, and a Greece 2028 overnight field trip.
summary: The agenda covers a lease for the APC Tides Program, an enrollment memo, and a math curriculum review process. It also includes first and second readings of several policies and a second reading of a 2028 world language trip to Greece over April vacation.
items: Consent agenda: appointments of Donald Dutton (BPS Food Service), Sarah Thompson (BPS Ed Tech III), Gerard Lapierre (Bus Driver), and Ally Thompson (BMS Ed Tech II)
Consent agenda: resignation of Rebecca Shaw-Hill (BPS FLS Ed Tech II), due to retirement
Advisory Committee on Policy: summary of meeting 10/14/2026
First reading of policies to adopt: DKC (Travel Expense Reimbursement), KF-R (School Facilities Fee Schedule), and JLCEA (Students with Diagnosed Allergies and Sensitivities)
First reading of policies to review or revise: JJIC-R, KF, BDB, BEC, BEC-R, BID, DD, EBCA (2025), and EHB
Second reading of overnight field trip: World Language Trip to Greece 2028, April Vacation 2028, teachers in charge Cassily and McGovern
